# Sotto

![Sotto](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/creazy231/Sotto/main/docs/listing/screenshots/hero.png)

**Whispers in a calm messenger window, drawn in the EllesmereUI look.**
A whisper messenger for World of Warcraft, in the spirit of WIM, with only the options that
matter. One download for Retail, every Classic version (Classic Era, Anniversary, Mists of
Pandaria, Cataclysm, Wrath, Titan-Reforged) and WoW Forever.

## What it does

- **One window for every whisper.** Character whispers and Battle.net whispers, incoming
  and outgoing. A slim rail on the left holds one badge per conversation: class icon,
  unread count, offline contacts greyed out. Shift-click a badge to close its
  conversation.
- **Or a window for each.** Prefer WIM's way? Turn on "Separate windows" and every
  conversation gets its own window. "–" minimises one to the dock (the rail, on its
  own); shift-click it to close the conversation and delete its history. A window you
  move or resize keeps its place.
- **Reads like a messenger.** Name and time once per run of messages, day separators, a
  "New" line above what you have not read yet, clickable items, quests and links
  (links open a copy box).
- **Answer where you read.** Enter sends, long messages are split for you, Up and Down
  bring back what you sent, every conversation keeps its own draft, shift-clicked items
  land in the box.
- **Stays out of your way.** Out of combat the window opens on a new whisper; in combat a
  small card slides in instead (or always, if you prefer). No keyboard focus is taken
  unless you ask for it. The window fades while you are not using it.
- **Your whispers, your window.** Your reply key, "Whisper" in a player menu (a name in
  chat, a unit frame, friends, guild) and the group finder's "Send Message" or "Whisper
  Leader" open Sotto right away, and a whisper you start from the chat box continues there. Whispers are hidden from the normal chat window. (Inside
  dungeons and raids the game hides whispers from addons, so there your reply key and the
  menus stay with the normal chat.)
- **Remembers.** Conversations survive reloads and logouts (7, 30 or 90 days, or until
  logout).
- **Matches your UI.** With EllesmereUI it follows your panel colour, font and accent live;
  the accent can also be your class colour. Without EllesmereUI it uses the same palette
  and the game font.

## Boss fights and other lockdowns

During boss encounters, Mythic+ and rated PvP (and on some restricted maps) the game can
hide whisper contents from addons. Sotto shows a notice
then: those whispers stay in your normal chat and land in Sotto when the lockdown ends.
Sending from Sotto pauses during that time; your draft waits.

## Gamepad interface (WoW Forever)

With WoW Forever's gamepad interface on, Sotto steps aside: your whispers stay in the
game's own chat, which is made for the controller, and your reply keys and "Whisper" in
player menus answer there. Sotto opens no window or notification meanwhile (switching to
the gamepad interface closes them) and keeps a copy of your whispers for when you are back
on mouse and keyboard. You can still open it by hand.

## Commands and key bindings

| | |
|---|---|
| `/sotto` | open or close the window (with separate windows: the dock) |
| `/sotto settings` | open the settings |
| `/sotto reset` | put the window back where it started |

Key bindings (Options > Key Bindings > AddOns > Sotto): **Show or hide Sotto**, **Reply to
the last whisper**, **Whisper the last person you whispered**, **Next unread
conversation**. With "Use Sotto to whisper" on, your normal reply keys do the same, and
"Whisper" in player menus and in the group finder opens the conversation in Sotto. The minimap button and the
addon compartment open it too.

## Settings

Open the window when a whisper arrives (always, out of combat, never) · sound (soft chime,
the game's whisper sound, none) · hide whispers from the chat window · use Sotto to
whisper · separate windows · accent (class colour or EllesmereUI) · scale (50 to 200 %) · text
size · fade when idle · remember conversations · minimap button.

## Coming from WIM?

Sotto notices WIM and offers to turn it off (it disables WIM and EllesmereSkin_WIM and asks
for a reload), so whispers do not arrive twice.

## Development

The addon is plain Lua with no libraries. An offline suite runs it inside a fake WoW
client (WoW Forever by default; `tests/test_flavors.lua` plays a Retail or Classic client):

```sh
luajit tests/run.lua && luajit tests/syntax.lua
python3 -I tests/test_media.py   # needs Pillow
```

Media is generated: `python3 -I tools/make_media.py .` and `python3 -I tools/make_sound.py .`
(needs Pillow and ffmpeg). Releases: see [docs/RELEASING.md](https://github.com/creazy231/Sotto/blob/main/docs/RELEASING.md). When a
game version is patched, its new interface number goes into `## Interface` in `Sotto.toc`
(Retail loads only an exact match).

# Changelog

## 1.4.0

- Separate windows (Settings, Look; off unless you turn it on): every conversation in its
  own window, as in WIM. Each window is the chat you know, with the contact's class icon
  in its header. Its "–" minimises it; shift-click it, and it turns into a red cross,
  to close the conversation and delete its history. Windows open where the chat used to
  be and step down from there; one you move or resize keeps that place for its
  conversation, also after a reload.
- With separate windows on, the window itself becomes a slim dock: the rail with every
  conversation (open windows carry the accent bar, minimised ones their unread count),
  "+" to start one and the gear for the settings. The minimap button, `/sotto` and the
  Toggle key show and hide it.
- A whisper to a window hidden behind another brings it to the front. While you type in
  one window, or in combat, a notification card shows instead, so nothing covers the box
  you type in. The cards stay clear of the windows.
- Closing the window right after sending no longer brings it back when the server echoes
  your line, and the settings no longer jump back to the chat when a conversation is
  closed while they are open.

## 1.3.0

- The group finder's whisper entries now open Sotto right away, as "Whisper" in a player
  menu does, instead of the chat box first: "Send Message" on a listing in the group
  browser (WoW Forever and the Classic clients), "Whisper Leader" on a premade group and
  "Whisper" on someone who applied to your group.
- Shift-click a conversation in the rail to close it (the middle mouse button still does
  too).

## 1.2.0

- Scale in the settings (Look): 50 to 200 %, for the window, its menus, the notifications
  and the copy box. The window keeps its bottom-left corner where it is, and the
  notifications stay at that corner. Dragging the slider applies the new scale when you let
  go of the mouse; the mouse wheel changes it in steps of 5 %.

## 1.1.0

- WoW Forever's gamepad interface: Sotto now steps aside while it is on. Your whispers
  stay in the game's own chat, which is made for the controller: it shows them, plays its
  sound, and your reply keys and "Whisper" in player menus answer there. Sotto opens no
  window and no notification then (switching to the gamepad interface closes them) and
  quietly keeps a copy of your whispers, so your conversations are complete when you are
  back on mouse and keyboard. The window still opens by hand, and its settings say so at
  the top.

## 1.0.0

First release.

- Whispers and Battle.net whispers in one window: a rail of conversations (class icon,
  unread count, offline contacts greyed out) and the chat on the right.
- Grouped messages with day separators and a "New" line, clickable items, quests and
  links (links open a copy box), AFK, DND and "player not found" lines.
- Compose box: Enter sends and splits long messages, Up and Down recall what you sent,
  drafts per conversation, shift-clicked items go in.
- Your reply keys and "Whisper" in player menus open Sotto right away (outside instances),
  and whispers you start from the chat box continue in Sotto. Sotto never touches the
  game's own chat box.
- Out of combat the window opens on a new whisper; in combat a notification card slides
  in instead. A soft chime, the game's whisper sound, or none.
- Boss fights and other chat lockdowns: whispers stay in your normal chat and arrive in
  Sotto afterwards; sending pauses and your draft waits.
- History kept for 7, 30 or 90 days, or until logout.
- In-window settings, a minimap button with the unread count, `/sotto`, key bindings
  (including "whisper the last person you whispered").
- Follows EllesmereUI's panel colour, font and accent live; class colour accent by
  default.
- Battle.net friends: whispers from a boss fight arrive afterwards too, a whisper to an
  offline friend says so, and friends WoW Forever whispers by character keep one
  conversation.
- What another addon hides from the chat window (a spam filter, for example) stays out of
  Sotto too; reporting a player removes their whispers, as the chat window does.
- Offers to turn off WIM so whispers do not arrive twice.
- One download for Retail, every Classic version (Classic Era, Anniversary, Mists of
  Pandaria, Cataclysm, Wrath, Titan-Reforged) and WoW Forever.
